notes.title: Steam Summer Sale and next Update
notes.notes:
Dear friends, followers, fans and haters, we want to inform you that Island Simulator 2016 is now 75% off !


We know that progress of this game are going very slow and we dont publish any updates since the game was published on Steam, but we are working very hard on this game and we want to finish this game. We spent a lots of money and lots of time on Island Simulator but we still need more time to fix bugs and improve gameplay.

We are now focused on fixing bugs and we want to add new content ! 


Thanks to everyone for playing the game and giving their feedback, we really appreciate all the help and support.


Sincerely,
Silverline Studios
Patryk Taranek
